title: Held-out wound single-cell population dynamics
description: Software for reconstructing a held-out acute human wound distribution and evaluating transfer to held-out donors. The study compares time coordinates, neural and non-neural predictors, training-donor counts, training seeds, mouse model arms, numerical integration and evaluation sampling. Three human donors provide biological replication; the study does not establish diabetic-foot-ulcer prognosis. This Zenodo deposit contains MIT software only. Manuscripts, artwork, source-study data, model weights and completed research outputs are excluded and retain their respective rights.
